label: Q1 scoreboard: ours (brush-cli main historical-build-084, default preset) vs gsplat 1.5.3 MCMC preset at our splat count (cap_max per scene), 13 tracker scenes x 3 same-runner pairs (ours seeds 1/2/3 | MCMC 42/43/44), L40S
method: Independent recompute from perview.jsonl (PSNR/LPIPS-VGG means, cross-checked against rows.jsonl metrics to 1e-6) and summary.json (train_s, NVML peak_used_mib - baseline_mib recomputed and matched to recorded peak_mib on all 78 runs); seed/cap echo parsed from gsplat-mcmc.log '@@ CONFIG'; provider from <scene>-s<n>.drive.log ('modal call'), same rule as table.py. Read-only, CPU only.

quality.rule: paired LPIPS-VGG <= MCMC on >=10/13 AND mean dPSNR >= 0

memory.rule: paired NVML-minus-idle <= MCMC on >=10/13 (MiB both arms)

registered_rule.row: AHEAD (all three axes) under the registered rule; lane numbers reproduce (mean dPSNR +0.223; speed 0.17-0.25; memory 0.50-0.71)

seed_gate.lpips_guard: PASS: no scene has dLPIPS > 0 (every scene and every pair favours ours)
seed_gate.psnr_guard: FAIL: 3 scenes below -0.05 dB: flowers -0.430, train -0.236, treehill -0.232 (each 3/3 seeds negative). A seed-gated 'AHEAD on PSNR' claim is not permitted; PSNR is reported as a mean with the losses named.
seed_gate.verdict: Quality AHEAD is admissible as an LPIPS-VGG claim (gate pass, guard pass). PSNR: mean +0.22 dB passes the gate but fails the per-scene guard -> 'mixed, mean +0.22 dB'.

checks.pairs_complete: PASS 39/39, rc 0 on all 78 runs, 30000 steps both arms (gsplat steps echoed in CONFIG)
checks.same_runner_per_pair: PASS: both arms in one request per (scene, seed) by harness construction (one summary.json per pair with one runner record). Runner driver varies across pairs (580.95.05 / 590.48.01 / 610.57.04), never within a pair.
checks.alternating_order: PASS: ours first on odd seeds (s1, s3), MCMC first on s2, all 39
checks.count_matching: PASS with disclosure: gsplat cap_max echoed in gsplat log == caps.json on 39/39 and gsplat achieved == cap on 39/39; caps come from our q1t-historical-build-019 achieved counts, not from the paired historical-build-084 run, so our paired achieved count differs from the cap by -0.53% to +1.29% (gsplat/ours count ratio 0.987-1.005). Near-equal, not exact; disclose.
checks.one_ours_binary: PASS: sha historical-build-084 on 39/39, brush_sha256 772a7722...9b6f on 39/39
checks.seed_echo: PASS for gsplat (CONFIG seed == 41+ours seed on 39/39). Ours: seed passed via --seed and recorded in summary.json; brush log has no seed echo line (harness-level echo only).
checks.lpips_scale: PASS: lpips_scale=full, n_scored == n_expected, identical view sets per pair, 78/78 runs
checks.provider: 6/39 pairs on Modal L40S, all seed 1: bicycle, drjohnson, garden, kitchen, room, train. MISMATCH in the lane table: its provider column is built from unordered glob() output, so the slot positions are wrong for 5 of 6 scenes (e.g. kitchen shows fal/fal/modal; actual modal/fal/fal). Counts per scene are right. Mixing providers is not material for the ratios: each ratio is within one pair on one runner; Modal-pair ratios (speed 0.152-0.235, mem 0.509-0.652) sit inside the fal-only range (speed 0.165-0.259). Disclose; fix the column.
checks.health_metric: MISSING on both arms: no health/degeneracy field in summary.json, rows.jsonl or logs. Flag; not a verdict blocker under the registered rule, which names none.
checks.warmup: Disclosed asymmetry: ours warm-up = one full 30k default run (fills the CubeCL autotune cache; header comment says '1.2M' but cap=None, so default budget); gsplat warm-up = 2000 steps (as GS-EQ, as registered). Both discarded.
checks.clocks: Ours train_s = brush 'train_only_s' (first to last optimizer step, GPU-synced); gsplat train_s = torch.cuda.synchronize + perf_counter from the first rasterize call of step 0 to after the last step (gs_run.py). Equivalent definitions; both exclude eval/render/export. gsplat loader stock (num_workers 4, pin_memory, preload off, echoed 39/39).
checks.memory_measure: NVML memory.used, 100 ms sampler (10 Hz, not the 20 Hz splat-perf sampler named as preferred), same sampler both arms, peak minus pre-launch idle, MiB both sides. Meets the registered condition.
checks.competitor_recipe_source: MISMATCH vs registration: registered 'gsplat 937e299, R-oracle run.py'; ran gsplat 1.5.3 examples/simple_trainer.py MCMC preset (authors' defaults) via the GS-EQ gs_run.py wrapper, with changes: cap_max = our count, seed patch, no in-run eval/ckpt/ply. MCMC strategy is not affected by the 937e299 DefaultStrategy opacity-reset bug. Cite as 'gsplat 1.5.3 simple_trainer MCMC preset (authors' defaults), cap_max set to our per-scene count'.
checks.fairness: Ours at defaults vs gsplat count-matched (a deliberate configuration, not gsplat's default cap of 1M and not gsplat tuned). No test-view selection in this run: caps come from a training-count run, configs fixed before launch, all 13 scenes reported. Recipe-level contamination: our default recipe and budget formula were developed on these 13 tracker scenes (disclosed by the lane; held-out check is q1-heldout-historical-build-096, not verified here).

mismatches: gsplat version/source: registered 937e299 + R-oracle run.py; ran gsplat 1.5.3 simple_trainer via gs_run.py
table provider column slot order wrong (glob order); all 6 Modal pairs are seed 1
caps from q1t-historical-build-019 counts, not the paired historical-build-084 counts (-0.53..+1.29%)
health metric missing on both arms
memory sampler 10 Hz (100 ms), not 20 Hz splat-perf (allowed: same sampler both arms)
run.py header says ours warm-up at 1.2M; it ran at the default budget (cap=None)
class: PROVISIONAL (registered class_max). The stated reason (1 MCMC seed) no longer applies after the 3-seed amendment; raising the class needs a pubs amendment plus the recipe-source correction.

verdict.quality: AHEAD (LPIPS-VGG: 13/13 scenes, 39/39 pairs, seed gate pass); PSNR mixed, mean +0.22 dB, losses on flowers -0.43, train -0.24, treehill -0.23
verdict.speed: AHEAD at equal splat count (train_s 0.17-0.25x of MCMC, 13/13)
verdict.row: AHEAD under the registered rule, PROVISIONAL, with the count-matched scope wording below

permitted_wording: At equal splat count (gsplat-MCMC at our splat count: gsplat 1.5.3 simple_trainer MCMC preset with cap_max set to our per-scene count; our engine at its default preset), on 13 tracker scenes x 3 seed pairs on L40S, each pair run back to back on one runner: our engine trains in 0.17-0.25x the time (first-to-last optimizer step) and uses 0.50-0.71x the GPU memory (NVML peak minus idle, MiB), with lower LPIPS-VGG on 13/13 scenes and a mean PSNR of +0.22 dB (lower PSNR on flowers -0.43, train -0.24, treehill -0.23 dB). Equal count, not equal quality and not tuned-vs-tuned; our defaults were developed on these scenes. PROVISIONAL.
forbidden_wording: 'faster than gsplat' / '4-6x faster than gsplat' without 'at our splat count'
'gsplat-MCMC' unqualified or 'gsplat defaults' for this arm
'better quality than gsplat-MCMC' or 'higher PSNR on every scene'
any equal-quality speed claim from these rows (GS-EQ / GS-EQ-SWEEP cover that)
